user.title: Plant Care
user.description: Connect to OpenPlantbook for species care ranges. Create API credentials at {api_keys_url}.

data_description.weather_entity: Used for outdoor plants (garden, balcony). Can be overridden per plant.

reconfigure.title: Plant Care settings
reconfigure.description: Change the OpenPlantbook credentials ({api_keys_url}) or the default weather entity.

data_description.weather_entity: Used for outdoor plants (garden, balcony). Can be overridden per plant.

error.invalid_auth: OpenPlantbook rejected the client ID or secret.
error.rate_limited: OpenPlantbook rate limit reached. Try again later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Plant Care is already set up. Add plants to the existing entry.

user.title: Add plant
user.description: Name the plant. To use species care ranges, type part of its name to search OpenPlantbook; leave the search empty to add the plant without a species.

data_description.species_search: Latin or common name, e.g. monstera.

data_description.species_pid: Matches from OpenPlantbook. Leave empty to add the plant without a species.
data_description.location_type: Indoor plants use room sensors; outdoor plants use weather and rain.
data_description.area_id: Room or place where the plant lives. Change it later by moving the plant's device.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Optional. When set, it takes priority over the estimate.
data_description.weather_entity: Outdoor plants only. Leave empty to use the hub default.
data_description.initial_watering_interval_days: Starting interval in days; it adapts to the watering you log.
data_description.feeding_interval_days: Days between feedings in spring and summer; longer in autumn and winter.
data_description.photo_upload: Optional. A JPEG, PNG or WebP of your plant, up to 10 MB. Without one, the species photo from OpenPlantbook is shown.

reconfigure.title: Edit plant
reconfigure.description: Change anything and submit. To move the plant to another room, change the area of its device. Range fields show the OpenPlantbook values; change one to override it, or clear it to use the species default.

data_description.species_pid: Leave empty to remove the species from this plant.
data_description.species_search: To choose another species, type part of its name and submit: the matches are added to the species list.
data_description.location_type: Indoor plants use room sensors; outdoor plants use weather and rain.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Optional. When set, it takes priority over the estimate.
data_description.weather_entity: Outdoor plants only. Leave empty to use the hub default.
data_description.initial_watering_interval_days: Starting interval in days; it adapts to the watering you log.
data_description.feeding_interval_days: Days between feedings in spring and summer; longer in autumn and winter.
data_description.photo_upload: Upload a new photo to replace the current one. Without a photo of your own, the species photo from OpenPlantbook is shown.
data_description.remove_photo: Go back to the species photo from OpenPlantbook.

error.invalid_photo: The photo must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 10 MB.
